name: g2_calern_halpha_be_disks
label: C2PU 15 m pair at H-alpha: the emission-line disks of gamma Cas (declination limit overridden) and zeta Tau, one night each, both branches
notes: Be stars in the H-alpha filter: photosphere + elliptical Gaussian disk carrying the line (targets' line_disk; hbtsim.single.line_disk_vis2). 'nights to 5 % on theta' is on the disk's FWHM with the line strength known from a spectrum.
gamma Cas needs the declination limit overridden (telescope c2pu_1m_override, Kaiser 2026-11-06): not an official configuration.
The line strengths are those of 2022 (gamma Cas) and 2022-2024 (zeta Tau): ASSUMED for November 2026.
